.claude/docs/conventions.md: - Default to writing no comments — only when WHY is non-obvious (hidden constraint, subtle invariant, workaround for specific bug).
.claude/docs/gotchas.md: _Wrap-session appends new entries below as they emerge from implementation work._
.claude/docs/services/config-watcher.md: - `.claude/rules/security.md` — the Settings-extension pattern and its derive constraints
.claude/docs/services/corpus.md: - **Tests:** 88 corpus tests (as measured at chunk 2026-10-04-declared-rust-floor-matches-the-code); cover schema, encryption, keychain (fake + real-store re-exec legs, incl. the concurrent `race_free` witness and the skip-arm no-residue witness), inspection metadata.
.claude/docs/services/curation.md: - **Tests:** unit tests inline with each primitive; integration via `snapshot` end-to-end.

.claude/docs/services/mcp-server.md: - `.andromeda/obs-plan.md` §1 P3 (must-trace `mcp.session` family) + §3 stderr forced JSON / stdout reservation
.claude/docs/services/triage.md: - **Tests:** unit tests inline per sub-module; integration via boot-smoke + cue emission scenarios.

.claude/docs/workflow.md: - For Tauri webview debugging in dev: `cargo tauri dev` opens DevTools automatically when `WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1` is set on Linux; Cmd+Opt+I on macOS; F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I on Windows.
.claude/rules/frontend.md: - 2026-09-29: UNDER vitest 4, `vi.restoreAllMocks()` NO LONGER CLEARS A `vi.fn()`'s CALL HISTORY, so a suite that relied on it in `afterEach` to reset call counts carries counts across tests and a `toHaveBeenCalledTimes` assertion fails on a later test. Clear history explicitly (`vi.clearAllMocks()`, or `mockClear()` per mock) wherever a test asserts call counts.

.claude/docs/services/security.md: - **Tests:** 85 in the crate suite (`cargo nextest list -p security --profile ci`, chunk 2026-09-30-span-level-redaction; 54 before). They cover per-category recall, the false-positive corpora (high-entropy identifiers, key/predicate column identities, non-card digit runs), Luhn-valid card forms, a proptest that `Redacted` never carries content, and 31 `span_mask` pins (embedded canaries per category, verdict equality, extents, merges, single-token parity, idempotence) with seeds in `proptest-regressions/scrubber.txt`.

.claude/docs/commands.md: - Views: `symbol` / `refs` / `calls` / `contains` / `crate_edges` / `calls_m`. Schema + canonical query shapes: `scripts/code-graph-cookbook.md` (authoritative definitions in `scripts/code-graph-views.sql`).

.claude/rules/security.md: - 2026-10-10: Harness code that runs INSIDE the product's process (a preloaded library, an injected hook) is never classed routine harness evidence on the operator's reading alone: record its classification PROVISIONAL, name the reading and its date, and leave the class to the founder's own word. A harness-only variable the product's own code never reads is a different class and keeps its own rule.

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-10-12: A PIN THAT MATCHES A STRING CONSTANT IN RUST SOURCE TEXT breaks when the constant is written with a `\` line continuation, because the backslash and the next line's indentation stay in the source text; keep such a constant on one source line, or compare the string's value instead.

.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-10-10: Read a count or a verdict out of a captured gate log by its own summary, never by a line grep: in the gate tool's capture of a nextest run each `PASS` line appears twice (90 lines for 45 tests), so the test count is the `Summary` line's; and a grep for `"name"` or `"ok"` over the pre-push check's log matches its libtest-JSON test lines, so the verdict object is read from the log's tail.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-08-26: THE ALLOWLIST FALLBACK HAS A THIRD SHAPE — it can resolve to a POPULATED SIBLING set, which is worse than resolving to nothing. The two shapes already recorded above are (a) no bare prefix key exists, so `for_target` resolves NOTHING and every field redacts (the `app.`-prefixed leaves), and (b) a bare key exists carrying only `value`/`unit`/`module`, so a `metric.*` target keeps `value` and silently loses its labels. The third: a bare key exists AND carries a full, unrelated field set. `buffer.consumer.stalled` falls back to the `buffer` key — which holds the ten `buffer.tick` counters and NONE of that target's four fields — so the target RESOLVES SUCCESSFULLY and every field still vanishes. That is the most deceptive of the three, because a resolver probe asserting `for_target(target).is_some()` passes. Two consequences for any new dotted target under an existing module key: assert the leaf's field SET, never merely that it resolves; and pin a DISCRIMINATOR that the fallback set does NOT contain the target's fields — without it, deleting the exact leaf leaves the guard passing vacuously, which is exactly the failure the guard exists to catch. Verified at `2026-08-26-ingest-consumer-stall-under-sustained-load`: `stall_fields_are_absent_from_the_buffer_fallback_set` is that pin, and the leaf's own test asserts set equality in both directions (a narrowed leaf and a widened one both fail). **[extended 2026-08-26] A FOURTH shape needs no fallback at all: the target has its OWN exact leaf, and the leaf is INCOMPLETE.** Then `for_target` resolves to the right entry, the fields it names render fine, and only the omitted ones read `"<redacted>"` — a PARTLY redacted target that no resolver probe and no gate can see, because half the record looks healthy. It is how a target sits mis-diagnosed for months: the 2026-08-15 muted-diagnostic census recorded five targets as "resolving to no allowlist entry" when measurement found that true for exactly ONE — two fell back to the bare `metric` key, and TWO (`triage.cue.tick`, `interpretation.model.load`) had exact leaves missing a field each. **The mechanism decides the repair** — "complete the leaf" versus "add a leaf" — so a census that records the wrong one sends its owner to the wrong edit. Consequence for the guard: the set-equality assertion above is what catches this; a resolver probe cannot. Mutation-proven at `2026-08-26-cadence-runaway-blocking-pool` — narrowing `triage.cue.tick` back to its pre-fix 5-of-7 leaf turned the field-set and un-mute pins RED while `cue_tick_resolves_to_an_exact_leaf` **stayed green**.
